use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant (SYS-13) for drafting, summarizing, meeting recaps, and file search across the holding company and all three subsidiaries
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite provider's enterprise generative AI add-on (vendor-hosted large language model in the group tenant); no custom model or fine-tuning
data_categories: Prompts and anything the user can open in SYS-03: email, chat, 41 collaboration sites, internal meetings; includes Restricted data (Finance customer information, employee SSNs and bank details, benefits enrollment data, vendor bank details, acquisition information)
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: employees, Finance consumers, subsidiary customers, and vendors whose data it can surface or who receive drafted messages)
consequential_decision_category: None (use in Employment or Credit decisions is prohibited by POL-05 4.9 and would re-tier to High)
human_in_the_loop: User reviews every output before use; second Finance reviewer for borrower replies during the pilot; HR reviews AI-drafted job postings; bilingual review of translated customer messages; no agent actions
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 314.4(c)(1)-(2), (e)(1), (f), (g), (i)(2) (Finance); Fla. Stat. 501.171; Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) for meeting transcription; ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4, 1002.9) and federal employment discrimination law if misused for decisions; FTC Act Section 5
status: Pilot (25 users since 2026-07-06); approved with 6 conditions 2026-09-25; no new users until conditions are met; expansion not before 2027-01-31
